terms.gloss: method, the way something is done
terms.comment: With a gerund in the genitive for the process itself: ratiō dēlendī, the way of rubbing out.

evidence: Verg. G. 3.504: sīn in prōcessū coepit crūdēscere morbus
terms.comment: Classically an advance, or the course of something (an illness, a speech, a person’s progress); not a procedure.

phrases.latin: scrībī optimē cērīs, in quibus facillima est ratiō dēlendī
phrases.english: it is best to write on wax, where rubbing out is easiest

phrases.latin: sīn in prōcessū coepit crūdēscere morbus
phrases.english: but if in its course the disease begins to grow worse

sources: Lewis & Short: ratio · Lewis & Short: processus
